summary: Jitendra Nath Banerjea was a scholar of Indology, history, and archaeology who studied under Hemchandra Raychaudhuri. Around 1918 to 1959, he served as Carmichael Professor of Ancient Indian History and Culture at the University of Calcutta.

Jitendra Nath Mohanty was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied at Presidency University, the University of Calcutta, and the University of Göttingen. He held teaching posts at Calcutta, Burdwan, The New School, Oklahoma, and Temple University (circa 1986–2012).

Jitsuaki Oshika is a scholar in Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology. He studied at Tohoku University from circa 1941 to 1944 and served as a professor at Toyo University from circa 1965 to 1990.

Jitsuzo Kuwabara was an archaeology, Sinology, and Central Asian studies scholar who studied at the University of Tokyo. He held posts at the Third Higher School, Tokyo Higher Normal School, and Kyoto Imperial University (1909–1930).
Jiun Kubota is a religious and Buddhist studies figure. He studied under traditional teacher Kyozo Yamada and later succeeded him.

Jivnesh Sandhan is a researcher in computational linguistics and Indology. He completed doctoral studies under Laxmidhar Behera (attested 2023) and holds a post at the Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad (attested 2025).

Jiyu Ren was a scholar of religion, philosophy, and Buddhist studies who studied at Peking University under Lin He and Yongtong Tang. He held positions at Peking University, the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, and the National Library of China.
Jo Khyab Pema Trinlé Nyingpo studied under Shenphen Nangwa and Pema Wangchok Gyelpo.

Joachim Gentz is a scholar of Sinology, religious studies, and philosophy. He was Junior Professor in Religious Studies at the University of Göttingen and later served as Reader in Chinese Studies (attested 2013) and Professor (attested 2026) at Edinburgh.
Joachim Prandstetter is a scholar in Indology and philosophy. He studied at the University of Vienna, completing his Magister by 1994, and studied under Gerhard Oberhammer.

Joachim Wach was a religious studies and philosophy scholar who studied at Leipzig and Heidelberg. He held academic posts at the University of Leipzig (1924–1935), Brown University (1935–1946), and the University of Chicago (1945–1955).

Joan Halifax is a Buddhist and religious studies scholar who studied at Newcomb College and Union Institute & University. She held posts at Columbia, Maryland Psychiatric Research Center, and Harvard, and founded the Ojai Foundation and Upaya Zen Center.
Joanna Cook is a religious and Buddhist studies scholar who studied under advisor James Laidlaw and held a post at Christ's College, University of Cambridge.

Joanna Gottfried Williams was an Indology, history, and archaeology scholar. She studied at Swarthmore College, Radcliffe College, and Harvard University, and served as a professor at the University of California, Berkeley from circa 1971 to 2011.
Joanna Jurewicz is a scholar of Indology, linguistics, and philosophy who studied under Maria Krzysztof Byrski. She holds a professorship at the University of Warsaw (attested 2006, 2026).
Joanna Macy was a scholar in Buddhist and religious studies. She completed her studies at Wellesley College (circa 1946–1950) and Syracuse University (circa 1973–1978).

Joanne Punzo Waghorne is an Indology and religious studies scholar who studied at the University of Chicago. She held posts at the University of Massachusetts Boston, Bowdoin College, UNC Chapel Hill (1987–2002), and Syracuse University.

Joe Bransford Wilson is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He earned his Ph.D. at the University of Virginia, taught there from 1981 to 1985, and later taught at the University of North Carolina Wilmington (attested 1994–2001).

Joe Cribb is a numismatist and historian of Indology and Central Asia who studied at Queen Mary University of London. He was Keeper of Coins and Medals at the British Museum (1970–2010) and held posts at Oxford and Hebei Normal.
Joen Imai is a Buddhist studies scholar who has served as a professor at Shuchiin University (attested in 2010 and 2026).
